mapping.summary: Syncs products, inventory, orders, customers with Shopify
claims: Pushes products, variants, images, metafields, metaobjects and collections to Shopify
Pushes stock per location with optional unit cost updates
Syncs base prices and customer-group price lists; optional SparkLayer for B2B
BC shipments fulfil Shopify orders incl. click-and-collect
Writes confirmations and invoices back to Shopify and marks paid
Syncs B2C contacts and B2B company accounts with locations and catalogs
Credit memos to Shopify refunds and Shopify refunds to return orders, with Narvar integration
Real-time order import via webhooks with tag/source filtering and split fulfilment
Imports third-party fulfilments as sales shipments with tracking
OmniConnect Portal to monitor flows, get notified and resubmit failed transactions
